scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix game-server && npm install --prefix game-client
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix game-server" "npm run dev --prefix game-client"
scripts.share: npm run build --prefix game-client && concurrently --kill-others -n server,client,ngrok -c blue,magenta,green "PORT=3100 npm start --prefix game-server" "GAME_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3100 npm run preview --prefix game-client -- --port 4173 --strictPort" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/share.mjs"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix game-server && npm test --prefix game-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix game-server && npm run typecheck --prefix game-client
